propositions: review-plan runs billable multi-pass LLM review on non-claimable tickets (terminal/paused status, open tickets with unclosed dependencies), producing unusable attestations and forcing re-review once blockers land
review-plan must fast-fail before context assembly and LLM invocation for non-claimable tickets, returning unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict with no LLM call and exit code 2
fast-fail must include a ticket-not-claimable finding with reason and remediation text; --force flag or force=True parameter must bypass the check to allow review of non-claimable tickets
in_progress tickets must never be fast-failed even with open blockers; bug and session_log tickets must remain gate-exempt; fast-fail must perform no LLM or network calls
